summary: Invivyd filed an 8-K disclosing it received a 12-month advanced notice from the FDA that the Emergency Use Authorization for its product PEMGARDA will terminate on June 29, 2027, following HHS termination of the COVID-19 EUA declaration. No specific deal terms, prices, or premiums are involved. The company states it will pursue permanent approval pathways. This is a regulatory update on a product authorization status, not a special situation transaction.
